How it works

One app, built for three kinds of people

Whether you are hunting for a price, running a shop, or waiting on a delivery, Priced Ug is shaped around what you actually need to do.

For everyone

No sign-in needed

Anyone can open the app and start browsing straight away. No account, no barrier.

  • Browse businesses

    A grid of business pages you can filter by category — food, clothing, electronics and more — or search by name.

  • View a business page

    Banner photo, description, address and a full product list. Every product shows its photo, price in UGX, size and materials.

  • Contact instantly

    Call buttons are everywhere, so you can reach a business or place an order in a single tap.

  • Read reviews

    See ratings and comments left by other customers before you buy.

For business owners

Sign in required

Your shop, your page. Everything you need to get found and take orders.

  • Create your business page

    Every owner gets exactly one page that they fully control, from banner to address.

  • Manage products

    Add, edit and delete products with photos, prices, descriptions, sizes and materials.

  • Reply to reviews

    Respond once to each customer review, so buyers hear your side too.

  • Look up customers for delivery

    Enter a customer's number and district to pull up their saved delivery details — address, a map pin, and the address photo of the house, gate or landmark. Message them, or share and copy the location.

For customers

Sign-in optional

Set your delivery details once, and every business you order from already knows how to find you.

  • Save a delivery profile

    Name, phone, district, street, a map location and an address photo — stored once, ready for every order.

  • Be found first time

    When you order, the business already has everything it needs to reach your door. No long directions over the phone.

  • Leave reviews

    One review per business, with a 1–5 star rating and an optional comment.

Features

Everything you need to buy and sell locally

No clutter, no complicated checkout. Just the details that matter when you are deciding where to shop.

  • 01

    Real prices in UGX

    Every product lists its actual price. No guessing, no asking, no back-and-forth before you know what something costs.

  • 02

    Filter by category

    Food, clothing, electronics, beddings, boda boda parts, bookshops and more — narrow the grid to what you actually need.

  • 03

    Search by name

    Know the shop already? Type the name and go straight to its page.

  • 04

    One-tap contact

    Call buttons throughout the app connect you to the business immediately.

  • 05

    Ratings & reviews

    Honest 1–5 star reviews from real customers, with owner replies for balance.

  • 06

    Delivery made simple

    Saved delivery profiles carry a map pin and an address photo, so drivers find the right gate the first time.

The app

A look inside

Clean, fast, and built for the way people actually shop in Uganda.

  • Browse and filter every listing by category, location and price.

  • Each business page carries its full product list and a call button.

  • Manage your account, delivery profile and business page.

  • Sign in only when you want to sell, review or save a delivery profile.

Leadership

The people behind Priced Ug

Priced Ug is built by people who know logistics, operations and the Ugandan market first-hand.

Tomasi Kiggundu

Chief Executive Officer

A logistics and operations professional with an international background spanning Europe, Africa and the United States.

Tomasi studied Logistics at Nova College in Haarlem, North Holland, where he built a strong foundation in supply chain management, operations and business logistics.

Throughout his career he has gained hands-on experience in logistics coordination, operations management, media and entrepreneurship. He previously worked with GTV Uganda, and later served as a Junior Operations Manager (Logistics) at International Bike Group in Amsterdam, where he supported day-to-day operational planning and logistics processes. He also worked as a Logistical Clerk at AP Logistics in Amsterdam Sloterdijk, managing inventory, shipment coordination and warehouse operations.

Today he is co-owner of East African Tacos in Los Angeles, where he combines operational expertise with a passion for business, customer service, and bringing authentic East African flavours to the community.

His diverse international experience has strengthened his ability to adapt, solve complex operational challenges, and build businesses that prioritise efficiency, innovation and customer satisfaction. He is passionate about entrepreneurship, logistics, and creating opportunities that connect people, businesses and communities across borders.
